sources.entry: NoxKey - Keychain-based secret manager for API keys and tokens with Touch ID. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/No-Box-Dev/Noxkey) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: NoxKey is a macOS secret manager for API keys and tokens that stores them in the Keychain and unlocks them with Touch ID, per its listing in awesome-mac.
summary.what_it_does: The README was not available, so this summary relies on the awesome-mac listing only. The listing describes NoxKey as a Keychain-based secret manager for API keys and tokens, with Touch ID support. It is tagged Open-Source Software and Freeware in that list. Beyond these points, I could not confirm specific features, commands, or workflows.
use_cases: store API keys securely on a Mac
keep access tokens out of config files
notable: Uses the macOS Keychain for storage
Listed as open source and freeware in awesome-mac
caveats: README not available, so features and setup could not be verified
Appears to be macOS-only, based on Keychain and Touch ID
keywords: keep api keys out of code
